name: office-connector
description: Let Hermes work in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and classic Outlook. Drives the documents you already have open rather than producing new files, so edits appear in the window in front of you and Word changes arrive as tracked revisions you can accept or reject. In Outlook it searches mail, calendar and contacts and composes messages and meetings, then opens them for you — it never sends or saves; you press Send. Windows for now.
